Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: The plan includes a comprehensive district-wide inventory covering all 26 school sites with detailed information on building age, size, portables, and specialized spaces. It provides a robust condition assessment of major systems (HVAC, plumbing, roofs, electrical, lighting, technology infrastructure, accessibility) using multiple data sources including facility audits and engineering assessments, and connects condition data to student outcomes and instructional priorities (Chunks 3-5).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: The plan provides detailed enrollment projections and capacity calculations by site and grade, using standard classroom loading ratios consistent with state standards. It connects capacity utilization to specific facility actions including removal or replacement of portables and addresses long-term facility needs such as school consolidation and adaptive uses (Chunks 5, 9).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with a dedicated Educational Specifications section developed by a committee including district leaders and principals. The plan integrates district mission, instructional priorities, and facilities planning, detailing how facilities support programs such as STEAM, Full Service Community Schools, Wall-to-Wall Academies, special education, and technology integration with specific facility requirements (Chunks 7-19).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: The plan provides data and analysis of outdoor spaces including playgrounds, fields, and school gardens with secure fencing. It identifies strategies for improvement such as covered outdoor learning areas with power and wireless access and connections to wellness, but does not provide districtwide data on green surface coverage or detailed climate resilience framing (Chunks 12, 15).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: The plan minimally acknowledges climate-related issues indirectly through references to energy efficiency and infrastructure upgrades but does not include a detailed climate risk assessment or comprehensive climate resilience strategies specific to multiple climate impacts (No explicit detailed climate risk assessment found in provided content).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: The plan mentions infrastructure and mechanical system upgrades including energy efficient models and lighting, but lacks detailed energy use data, comprehensive energy resilience strategies, or references to state mandates such as Title 24 or Zero Net Energy goals (Chunks 2-4).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: The plan presents a comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates for all projects including contingencies and soft costs, a clear prioritization framework, and multiple funding strategies including bonds and state programs. It considers long-term financial sustainability and aligns financial capacity with district priorities (Chunks 4-7).
